children: 385,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) Port Arthur, Texas, refinery was hit by a partial power outage on Tuesday night following the passage of Tropical Storm Edouard, said people familiar with plant operations.
The refinery’s AVU-147 crude distillation unit was shut by the power outage on the south side of the plant and the AVU-146 CDU was operating at the minimum crude processing level, the sources said.
Small crude unit shut, large crude unit operating at minimum, sources say
Tropical Storm Edouard made landfall Tuesday afternoon near Valero refinery
